result.analyst_notes: Short navigational sections opened with imperatives (Explore, Discover, Find out, Check out) and first-person plural 'we'. Leads with innovation and research, with scale claims about researchers as description. Commitments are stated in absolute terms ('lead the way', 'empower people') with little hedging. Stakeholders are addressed in sequence, not prioritized. Shareholders and safety are absent.
